notes.text: Scan 047, carrying the lighter lower-left number 46 (hand not independently attributed), read 2026-11-20. The leaf rewrites the displayed condition using the decomposition A tilde prime = B tilde prime disjoint-union C tilde prime and identifies the result as the MD rigidity condition on the maquette G underline prime. It then begins a proposition: for a maquette and a chosen subset C prime of its edge set, a generisation morphism is asserted to exist uniquely up to unique isomorphism; this leaf ends at the displayed morphism. The three local nouns read maquette(s), and the morphism word reads générisation. The unprimed A tilde beta in the second inequality is preserved as written. The small cancellations, terminal punctuation after the first maquettes, and middle letters of struck trouver remain uncertain. No independent proof check was undertaken.
